candidates.excerpt: A magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck Tibet on Thursday, killing 16 people and injuring 32 others. More than 300 houses collapsed, prompting rescue and relief operations. Officials are assessing the damage as the region faces renewed concerns over disaster vulnerability
